notes:
Language: pick the initial language from the visitor's device language (ca/es/en), with a manual switcher — do not hardcode a single default.

Assets: the owner has no asset pack. All photography must come from the Instagram and Facebook profiles (social scraping is enabled for this reason). The only owner-supplied files are the two menu photographs in .studio/assets/menu/.

Menu (must-have): the site needs its own menu, restyled to match the site rather than shown as the photographed PDF. It should open within the page — an overlay/viewer or similar — not as a separate page (site is one-page). Transcribe prices and dish names from .studio/assets/menu/menu-page-1.png and menu-page-2.png during research. The photographed menu is Spanish-only; the ca and en versions need translating. Sections seen: Per picar, Pa amb Oli, A la Brasa, Ensalades, Peix, Especialitats, Per a nens, Postres casolans.

Logo: no vector or transparent logo exists. The logo appears in both menu photographs ('Sa Pamboleria' script, with 'TERRASSA · PA AMB OLI' and 'CARNS A LA BRASA' curved around it). Owner's suggestion: use Magnific to extract/upscale it into a transparent-background asset for the site and the menu. Treat the approach as open — any route to a clean transparent logo is fine.

Hero idea (owner): a professional photograph of a pa amb oli, possibly with a hand reaching for it, cut out on a transparent background — product-showcase treatment in the spirit of the tacosmyguey.com reference.

Budget note: this client's only image source is paid scraping, and the logo and hero both likely need paid generation, against a EUR 3 budget. Expect the ledger to gate; ask the owner before spending rather than skipping the image work silently.
